name: Copilot Studio Agent Health Check
description: Statically lints an exported Copilot Studio agent for structural defects, across both the classic topic-based experience and the new agentic (skill-based) experience. Classic checks: trigger-phrase collisions, unreachable topics, missing fallback/escalation, slot-filling with no correction path, variable-lifecycle bugs. Agentic checks: skill-description collisions, missing or thin descriptions, empty instructions, unwired tool references. Cross-cutting checks: unsafe/unrecognised Power Fx, dead-end dialog branches, orchestration-aware trigger/description quality, OData parameter quoting, leaked-secret variable names, connected-agent handoff integrity. Deterministic, evidence-backed, one job — every finding carries a severity and a concrete fix. Reports defects in the artifact; it does not test security, model cost, or recommend a platform.
author: Anamika Kumari & Shilpa Gangaramani
